label: Reading scale suffixes
subgoals: Split the value into its mantissa and suffix
Replace the suffix by its power of ten
Divide by the target unit's power of ten

label: The M and MEG trap
subgoals: Treat M and m as milli in every case
Read MEG for mega and ignore trailing unit letters
Read a bare F after a number as femto

label: Computing with netlist values
subgoals: Convert each card's value to base units
Multiply the values to form the requested quantity
Express the product in the requested unit
